convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load the 'ColorZerolagHLR' custom indicator with multiple input parameters, and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution logic (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory). Both the custom indicator and the .mqh library must be manually replicated.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per timeframe bar for signal timestamp
derived_values.used_by: BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen signal time parameter

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: when Buffer0 crosses below Buffer1, long positions are closed (if BuyPosClose=true); when Buffer0 crosses above Buffer1, short positions are closed (if SellPosClose=true)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode input selects between LOT (fixed lots), PCT (deposit percentage), or other MarginMode enum values from TradeAlgorithms.mqh; MM=0.1 with LOT mode means 0.1 lots

custom_logic_notes: Signal detection uses bars at index SignalBar (default=1, previous bar) and SignalBar+1 (2 bars back): Osc1[1]>Osc2[1] checks if buffer0 was above buffer1 on bar SignalBar+1; Osc1[0]<Osc2[0] checks if buffer0 is below buffer1 on bar SignalBar - this constitutes a crossover from above to below (bearish crossover triggers long close and short open). The reverse logic applies for bullish crossover. Signal flags (BUY_Open, SELL_Open, etc.) are latched per bar and only reset on a new bar or recount. The UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime passed to trade functions uses SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec, effectively assigning the next bar open time as the signal time. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose boolean inputs gate whether each direction's open and close signals are acted upon.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorZerolagHLR custom indicator is a zero-lag HLR (High Low Range percentile) oscillator using 5 weighted HLR components with factors [0.05, 0.10, 0.16, 0.26, 0.43] and periods [8, 21, 34, 55, 89], smoothed by a 15-period smoothing. Each HLR component must be reimplemented: HLR ranks the current close within its period's high-low range as a percentile (0-100). The composite = sum(Factor_i * HLR_i) / sum(Factor_i), then smoothed. The crossover of buffer0 (uptrend colored line) vs buffer1 (downtrend colored line) is the core signal. TradeAlgorithms.mqh must be fully reverse-engineered to understand BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/SellPositionClose/BuyPositionClose behavior including how MMMode and signal time affect execution. SL/TP are in points (1000/2000) - must confirm if these are raw points or pips and handle 5-digit broker adjustment. The CIsNewBar class and LoadHistory function from the .mqh must also be replicated for new-bar detection and history loading.
